phases.text:
The cane comes down and the rat goes still beneath it — but the same swing is still carrying through when the bank beside you tears open and the Rat Mother comes out of it, vast and shrieking, the dog already snarling in at your side to meet her.

You swing for the Rat Mother and she's already turned from where you aimed.

The dog gets under her guard and rips into her flank.

The Rat Mother heaves and another rat comes spilling out of the nest at her side, then goes rigid with the effort.

The new rat snaps at the dog and catches only fur.

You catch the rat with the cane and it staggers sideways.

The dog's jaws close on it and shake it hard.

The Rat Mother stands frozen, spent, not moving.

The rat lunges for the dog's leg and misses.

You strike again and the rat reels.

The dog snaps at it and comes up empty.

The Rat Mother still hasn't moved.

The rat gets its teeth into the dog's flank and it yelps.

You bring the cane down on it again, hard.

The dog seizes it and snaps it still with one shake.

The Rat Mother surges back into the fight and catches the dog a heavy blow.

You swing at her and miss clean.

The dog tears into her side again.

She turns on the dog and doesn't connect.

You get the cane in on her for a solid hit.

The dog goes for her again and bites deep.

She swings for the dog and misses.

You swing and she's already moved.

The dog catches her again, worrying at the wound.

She lunges for the dog and doesn't find it.

Your swing goes wide.

The dog snaps at her and misses.

She swings for the dog and it isn't there.

Your footing goes on the blood-slick ground and the swing meant for her goes wide instead.

The dog goes for her again and comes away empty-jawed.

She turns on the dog once more and misses.

You find your feet and swing again, and she's already clear of it.

The dog tears into her once more and she staggers under it.

She catches the dog hard as it presses back in.

You swing at her and miss again.

The dog locks its jaws into her throat and doesn't let go until she stops moving.

fight.said: The cane comes down and the rat goes still beneath it — but the same swing is still carrying through when the bank beside you tears open and the Rat Mother comes out of it, vast and shrieking, the dog already snarling in at your side to meet her.
fight.name: the Rat Mother

note: A dog has been trotting at her heel since the crossing — it is hers now, or near enough. The nest in the roadside bank opens and the Rat Mother comes out of it, huge and hostile, and she will not flee. Declare the fight: the dog fights alongside her with 12 health, 1–3 damage, dc 12, bonus 2. The Rat Mother has 20 health, 2–4 damage, dc 12, bonus 2, and an ability that spawns a Rat (5 health, 1–2 damage, dc 10, bonus 1) and then leaves her not stirring for 2 rounds. athletics, dc 12 to hit her, their_dc 11, flee_dc 10.

proposal.summary: You drive the cane down for a finishing blow on the rat.

outcomes.text: the blow lands clean and the rat drops dead — and the bank beside it tears open, something far larger clawing out of a hidden nest, while the dog that's followed you since the crossing plants itself snarling at your side
the cane catches it hard enough to finish it, and before its body's even still the nest in the bank splits open behind it, huge and hostile, the dog already between you and it
the rat dies under the blow but the dog shoulders in ahead of you to meet what's coming out of the nest, throwing off your footing as the huge thing rears up

your cane is still finishing the rat when the nest erupts mid-swing, so the same motion that kills it carries straight into meeting the enormous thing lunging out behind, the dog snapping in beside you

the rat dies and in the instant the nest tears open the fog itself goes utterly still over that one patch of bank, as if something were holding its breath, before the huge shape and the dog both come forward into it

the rat drops and what climbs out of the nest looks back at you with eyes like two flat coins that catch no light at all, wrong in a way you have no word for, while the dog stands its ground against it anyway

chosen.text: your cane is still finishing the rat when the nest erupts mid-swing, so the same motion that kills it carries straight into meeting the enormous thing lunging out behind, the dog snapping in beside you
